g.text: CL68.1: a session opens on the guide
every path, from each project's root
every path unique, or it stops
the voice, its header, its skills/

text.tspan: The catalogue gathers each provider once and checks every path; the engine reads the guide's voice at
agents/louis-agent-guide/voice.md, the path it has in its project.
